body.text: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. RETARD (Retardatide, StonkFun) says "Paired to LLY. You get paid LLY stock just for holding retardatide", and CHAD (CHAD, LaunchLab) says "Backed by tokenized HIMS stock" (both d2:0, the coins' own descriptions). The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: six coins across all their pools.

Most recent observation of the story (Oct 28, 2026): Posts of 2026-10-25 to 2026-10-28 (e1:4): xstok says $CATE is now listed and verified on its launcher (2026-10-25); accounts say StonkFun switched on points that earn xStonk (2026-10-27 19:16-19:24 UTC); @Stonks_Exchange (2026-10-27 21:01 UTC) says tokens can be launched paired with listed stocks; a post of 2026-10-26 reports xStocks' tokenized equity network at $1B on-chain market cap. Launchpads and desks that pair coins with stocks keep announcing new pairs, but the coins are different products and the claims are the projects' own. STONK carries most of the narrative's volume.

Evidence on record: 1 project claim(s), 0 independent source(s) and 8 post(s).
